description: Fetch one proof card (JPEG) of a post in your campaign and return it as an image; optionally save it to a new local .jpg. A proof card is the Instagram reel tile as a VibeVO scan saw it (thumbnail, Instagram view count, handle, UTC time). Requires the read scope.

savePath.description: Optional new local file path ending in .jpg; an existing file is never overwritten.

name: vibevo_get_campaign_post_proof
title: Get a proof screenshot of a campaign post
